blocks.text: International Registrations Designating Australia (IRDA) have different requirements from standard applications in relation to registration.

Once an IRDA has gained protection in Australia, a notice of protection is sent to the IB and the Australian/New Zealand address for service (if one is recorded). This notice is attached to the file records, and includes the extent of the protection.
